text:
Alice (billing): Heads up — invoices for account ACME (ticket #4321) show ~18% more tokens than what the dashboard reports. Dashboard: 1,234,567 tokens; invoice: 1,460,000. Customer is escalated asking why. Anyone seen ingestion/metering lag around 2026-03-16 03:00-04:00 UTC?

Ben S.: I see a short event-store write error around 2026-03-16T03:14 UTC in the incident log. Could be buffered events getting replayed later which would inflate invoice vs snapshot on dashboard. Pinged metering-bot to confirm.

metering-bot: Incident detected: event-store write failures (502) between 2026-03-16T03:14:07Z and 2026-03-16T03:17:20Z. ~22k events buffered in internal queue. Replay not yet started.

Cory (eng-runtime): Querying consumer offsets + committed counts now.

# kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --describe --group metering-ingest
GROUP           TOPIC             PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG
metering-ingest metering-events    0          1452300         1454500         2200
metering-ingest metering-events    1          987600          988000          400
metering-ingest metering-events    2          562100          564600         2500

Cory (eng-runtime): Consumer lag ~5.1k across partitions. Looks like the buffered writes were later appended causing duplicate ingestion risk if we just replay naively. Need to dedupe by request_id and mark replayed events.

Dina (support): Customer wants ETA and whether we need to issue a provisional credit. Please update ticket #4321 with plan/ETA.

Ben S.: Plan: run a dry-run of the replay tool to estimate token delta, then run targeted replay for affected offsets with dedupe. Commands: 

# dry-run to estimate tokens
replay-tool --topic metering-events --from-offset 1452300 --to-offset 1454500 --dry-run --output=estimate.json
# actual replay (with dedupe keys)
replay-tool --topic metering-events --from-offset 1452300 --to-offset 1454500 --target=backfill-prod --dedupe-key=request_id

Dry-run output (summarized): would re-ingest ~22,500 events -> ~225,433 tokens across ACME.

Cory (eng-runtime): I ran a checksum and found 3 partitions with partial writes (some events in store lack the unique request_id header). For those, we need a transformation step to recover request_id from payload or apply timestamp-based dedupe window. I'll try running the replay for partitions 0 and 2 first.

Ben S.: Starting partitioned backfill now using incremental mode (avoids double-billing by marking replays as replay_source=eventstore-backfill and pipeline dedupe by request_id). Kicking job at 1775554500. ETA ~45m. Posting logs to the run: https://logs.internal/replay/987

metering-bot: Backfill job 987 initiated by Ben S. at 2026-03-16T04:01:40Z. Tracking id: replay-987.

Dina (support): Noted. I'll tell the customer we expect reconciliation in ~1h and that CS will follow up with an interim credit if needed. Please confirm token delta once backfill completes.

Cory (eng-runtime): Running reconciler after backfill: 

python tools/compare_billing.py --start 2026-03-16T03:00:00Z --end 2026-03-16T05:00:00Z --output=recon_acme_4321.csv
# sample check: SELECT sum(tokens) FROM metering.v_tokens WHERE account_id='ACME' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-16' AND '2026-03-17';

I expect final delta ~+225k tokens which matches dry-run. Will attach CSV to the ticket.

Ben S.: Backfill job log excerpt: 

[info] partition=0 reingested=11200 events tokens=112345
[info] partition=2 reingested=11300 events tokens=113088
[warn] partition=1 skipped (missing request_id) - manual review needed

Alice (billing): Good catch on partition 1. If partition 1 requires manual mapping, can we estimate exposure? How many tokens might still be missing/duplicated?

Cory (eng-runtime): Partition 1 estimated ~8k events -> ~80k tokens. For those we'll run a secondary transform job to infer request_id from payload or use strict timestamp-based de-dup window; that'll take additional ~2-3 hours. I'll open a PR with the transform and sequence number handling.

Dina (support): For the customer: we'll reconcile the bulk delta now (225,433 tokens) and then do a follow-up adjustment if partition 1 adds more. Flagging ticket as "escalated - in progress" and adding timeline.

metering-bot: Backfill job 987 completed at 2026-03-16T04:29:25Z. Results: total_reingested_events=22500 total_tokens=225433. No active consumer lag.

Ben S.: Backfill finished at 1775554965. I triggered the reconciliation script and uploaded recon_acme_4321.csv to the ticket. Invoice delta reconciles with reingested tokens; recommending a one-time invoice correction: refund equal to unit_price * 225,433 tokens.

Dina (support): Thanks — I'll draft the credit and update the customer. Leaving ticket open until partition 1 transform completes.

Alice (billing): Thanks team — great coordination. Please ping when partition 1 is resolved.

Ben S.: Will follow up in the same thread once partition 1 transform + secondary reconciliation completes.
